title: Pay for family band gigs
summary: The boys earned three then five dollars a gig, far more than classmates' allowances.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Let’s suppose you had a week in the summer and you played three gigs. What kind of money would you expect from your father, individually?

Originally I think we got three dollars, then it went up to five dollars. You know we were buying our own comic books when we were in school and we had more money than anybody in my class. Because you remember, five bucks back in the 50s was a considerable allowance. Most kids were getting 25 cents or 50 cents as an allowance if they got an allowance.
